note: 8 clips, 48 frames each at 24 fps (2 s). Every face shot in shots.json is 1.8 s or shorter. Reuse a clip with a different crop, push or flip in 2D; do not re-render. All clips: lead = Rocketbox Female_Adult_01, PINK SHIRT, Cycles CPU, 14 samples + denoise, AgX, about 712x1267 then upscaled to 1080x1920.

background_sets.bus: Night bus top deck, Peckham: cool-dark interior, wet steamed window behind her, ~90 warm amber emissive bokeh spheres sliding left to right (moving), a faint cool rim light, her seat mid-frame. Different light from the kitchen so the R1 cut reads.
background_sets.kitchen: Her kitchen at 10:12 pm: warm lamp key from camera left, cool window rim from behind, dark window, a few warm out-of-focus practical lights, a kettle blur. Warmer and smaller than the bus.

clips.notes: 2a is a whip pan INTO her face; start the clip on the hold
9a is a reflection in the dark phone screen: flip, darken and overlay in 2D
start at frame 10 (mid-snap); mouth light 0.4 W; hold under 1.1 s in the edit
hope for the first 0.4 s, then the open grin; head level
17b is a small inset in the corner over the shop app

budget: 8 clips x 48 frames = 384 frames at about 25-30 s a frame on a 2-core machine is about 3 hours; render in resumable 12-frame batches and check each batch. Lower to 10 samples if time matters.
